about: The app owner's own tested 1RMs (Research mode, Oct 2026), kept only as ratios to the same person's tested anchor lift (no body weight or absolute loads). One lifter, so each counts as a single vote next to the AI databases (V2 build only); never used for research lifts. Only exercises whose own anchor was tested are used: anchors aren't converted into each other, so leg extensions and leg curls (squat anchor, not tested) are left out.

ratios.test: estimated from a 6-rep set, per dumbbell
